page.title: Permissions and data access
page.description: See what this plugin can actually access and do. Select any permission for the host-defined boundary. Turning it off blocks the matching plugin calls.

preview.global: Plugin content can appear in shared app areas that persist across pages
preview.filePreview: The plugin can render a specialized content viewer in the file preview area
preview.activityTab: The plugin can add and populate a tab in the right-side activity panel
preview.inputAction: The plugin can add an action button to the conversation input
preview.message: Plugin content can be attached below a specific chat message
preview.toolCall: The plugin can present tool-call progress and results in a specialized card
preview.turnCard: The plugin can extend the card that contains an entire conversation turn
preview.workspaceView: The plugin can contribute a full-page workspace view with its own sidebar entry
preview.shortcuts: The plugin can listen for a registered key combination and trigger its action
preview.fileDecorations: The plugin can show status or type markers beside file entries
preview.fileContextMenu: Plugin actions can appear in file and folder context menus
preview.fileToolbar: The plugin can add action buttons to the file explorer toolbar

page.previewFlow: The arrow shows the data or action direction this permission enables

readOnly.install: This plugin is not installed. These are the permissions it requests; you will confirm the actual grants during installation.
readOnly.system: This is a built-in system plugin. Vetta manages and grants its permissions automatically, so they cannot be disabled individually.

scope.interface: Only allows presentation or interaction in the named UI location. It does not grant file or session data by itself.
scope.data: Limited to the data types exposed by the host API. The exact paths or records depend on the plugin call.
scope.agent: Applies to host-exposed Agent sessions, prompts, tools, or runtime state.
scope.execution: The host performs the operation, while the plugin chooses the command, page, or action to request.
scope.external: Can leave Vetta to open a target or make a request. The plugin supplies the destination at call time.
scope.intelligence: Uses your configured model or media services, may send plugin-composed input, and may consume service usage.

disabled.interface: The matching entry, content, or interaction will not appear. Other plugin features can continue to run.
disabled.data: Calls to read or change this data fail, so features that depend on it may be unavailable.
disabled.agent: The plugin cannot affect this part of Agent behavior, so related automation or enhancements may stop working.
disabled.execution: The host blocks the operation, and workflows that depend on its result may not complete.
disabled.external: The plugin cannot complete that external access. Features that do not need it remain available.
disabled.intelligence: Generation, analysis, and provider features that use AI or media services become unavailable.

description.uiSlotGlobal: Lets the plugin present interface content in shared app areas that may remain visible across pages.
description.uiSlotFilePreview: Lets the plugin show custom content or a viewer in the file preview area.
description.uiSlotActivityTab: Lets the plugin add a selectable tab to the right-side activity panel.
description.uiSlotInputAction: Lets the plugin add a clickable action near the chat input.
description.uiSlotMessage: Lets the plugin add custom content or actions below chat messages.
description.uiSlotToolCall: Lets the plugin customize how Agent tool-call results are presented.
description.uiSlotTurnCard: Lets the plugin show status or actions inside a conversation turn card.
description.uiSlotWorkspaceView: Lets the plugin contribute a full-page workspace view with its own pinnable sidebar entry.
description.uiShortcutsRegister: Lets the plugin register keyboard shortcuts and run plugin actions when they are pressed.
description.uiFileExplorerDecorations: Lets the plugin add icons, badges, or status hints to the file explorer.
description.uiFileExplorerContextMenu: Lets the plugin add actions to file and folder context menus.
description.uiFileExplorerToolbar: Lets the plugin add actions to the file explorer toolbar.
description.workspaceRead: Views metadata for open workspaces, folders, and file lists without directly reading file contents.
description.agentSessionRead: Reads messages, state, and related context from the current Agent session.
description.agentSessionWrite: Changes current Agent session state or content and may affect later conversation behavior.
description.agentCommandRun: Runs Agent commands declared and requested by the plugin through the host.
description.agentCommandSpawn: Starts background processes that can keep running until the plugin or host stops them.
description.captureOffscreen: Loads content in a hidden page environment and captures an image of it.
description.agentSystemPromptRead: Reads the system prompt that defines the Agent's baseline behavior.
description.agentSystemPromptWrite: Adds or changes plugin-managed content in the Agent system prompt.
description.agentSystemPromptFullControl: Replaces or reorganizes the full system prompt and can substantially change Agent behavior.
description.agentSkillsControl: Controls which skills the Agent loads and when they are available.
description.agentMcpControl: Provides Agent MCP services and tools managed by the plugin.
description.agentToolsControl: Enables, disables, or adjusts tools currently available to the Agent.
description.agentToolsRegister: Registers new Agent tool names, descriptions, and input shapes.
description.agentToolHandlerExecute: Runs plugin-provided handler logic when the Agent calls a plugin tool.
description.agentHooksRegister: Registers handlers that can observe or affect Coding Agent lifecycle events.
description.agentHookHandlerExecute: Runs plugin-provided hook logic when Coding Agent reaches a matching event.
description.agentStateRead: Reads Agent runtime state stored for this plugin.
description.agentStateWrite: Updates Agent runtime state stored for this plugin.
description.agentContinuationRegister: Decides whether the Agent automatically continues after a turn ends.
description.agentRuntimeConfigure: Adjusts Agent runtime configuration and may affect models, tools, or execution policy.
description.appActionsRegister: Registers app actions that can be called from the interface or other features.
description.appActionHandlerExecute: Runs plugin-provided handler logic when an app action is triggered.
description.aiModelsList: Views the AI models you configured and made available to plugins.
description.aiComplete: Sends plugin-composed input to a configured AI model and receives generated output.
description.fsRead: Reads the contents of files selected by the plugin through the host file API.
description.fsWrite: Creates, overwrites, moves, or deletes files selected by the plugin through the host file API.
description.networkFetch: Sends requests to network addresses selected by the plugin, possibly including data the plugin accessed.
description.storageRead: Reads persistent data private to this plugin and not directly available to other plugins.
description.storageWrite: Writes persistent data private to this plugin for state or configuration.
description.mediaGenerate: Calls configured image, audio, or other media-generation services.
description.mediaProviderRegister: Registers a media-generation service provided by the plugin with Vetta.
description.settingsRead: Reads app settings the host exposes to plugins.
description.settingsWrite: Changes app settings the host exposes to plugins and may alter app behavior.
description.shellOpenExternal: Opens a plugin-selected external link in the system browser or default app.
